messages.content: You write internal historical Council records. The supplied historical excerpts are the only factual authority.

{"task": "Write the public portion of a compact historical Council record in at most 85 words. Use one sentence per draft with its symbol, tally in numeric form and the reason it failed. Compare the proposed electoral and dialogue approaches, naming the dialogue mechanism. Compare the humanitarian approaches. State that neither draft conferred authority and give a brief labeled analytical suggestion. Use only the four supplied evidence IDs in brackets. Omit headings, repeated facts and discussion of unavailable sources.", "evidence": {"US-VOTE": "On 28 February 2019 the United States submitted S/2019/186. It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions. China and the Russian Federation voted against it as permanent members, and the draft was not adopted.", "RU-VOTE": "S/2019/190 was a separate Russian draft. It received four votes in favour, seven against and four abstentions and failed to reach the required number of affirmative votes.", "US-TEXT": "The U.S. draft called for a peaceful process toward credible presidential elections under international observation. It proposed unhindered humanitarian access and assistance across Venezuela consistent with humanitarian principles.", "RU-TEXT": "The Russian draft supported inclusive national dialogue, including the Montevideo Mechanism. It placed Venezuela’s Government in the lead on humanitarian assistance and called for its consent and appeal."}}

{"task": "In one short sentence or two, give the name and procedural capacity of the person who announced the results, and distinguish both national votes of his delegation. Cite [CHAIR]. Use a maximum of 28 words. Use only the supplied passage.", "evidence": {"CHAIR": "Ndong Mba of Equatorial Guinea announced both results as Council President. Equatorial Guinea itself abstained on S/2019/186 and voted for S/2019/190."}}

{"task": "In one short sentence or two, report both votes, the scope of dialogue urged and who was asked to accept whose good offices. Cite [INDONESIA]. Use at most 28 words. Use only the supplied passage.", "evidence": {"INDONESIA": "Indonesia abstained on both drafts. Its representative, Dian Triansyah Djani, urged inclusive political dialogue and called on all parties to accept the Secretary-General's good offices."}}
